components.text: Past the gate: evaluate the reform on adjacent cohorts. Otherwise: write it up on the old-threshold baseline and the power analysis, 20 months in all

notes: The plan runs 20 months, from October 2026 to the defense in May 2028. The first half year covers the literature, the policy and the pre-reform profile. The first half of 2027 covers the old-threshold baseline and the power analysis. June 2027 is the data gate, when I check whether CHARLS or CFPS has released a post-reform wave. If so, the second half of 2027 goes to design 2, the adjacent-cohort comparison. If not, I deepen the baseline and the power analysis and the thesis rests on them. Either way, writing starts in September 2027, the pre-defense is in March 2028 and the defense in May.
